subject: mechanical_engineering

resources.title: Engineering Dynamics
resources.notes: Kinematics, rigid-body dynamics, work-energy, Lagrange equations, linearization, and vibration with problems and exams.

resources.title: Fluid Dynamics
resources.notes: Hydrostatics, control-volume analysis, conservation laws, viscous flows, pipes, dimensional analysis, boundary layers, lift and drag.

resources.title: Thermal-Fluids Engineering 1: Basics of Thermodynamics and Hydrostatics
resources.notes: First and second laws, entropy, ideal gases, thermodynamic cycles, hydrostatics and integrated thermal-fluid engineering.

resources.title: Mechanics of Material Systems: An Energy Approach
resources.notes: Deformation, strain, stress, elasticity, plasticity, yield design and material modeling using thermodynamic principles.

resources.title: Dynamics
resources.notes: Advanced rigid-body dynamics, Hamilton and Lagrange formulations, stability, nonlinear oscillations, vibrations and wave propagation.

resources.title: Advanced Fluid Mechanics
resources.notes: Navier-Stokes, dimensional analysis, lubrication, boundary layers, vorticity, turbulence, lift/drag and surface-tension flows.

resources.title: Compressible Fluid Dynamics
resources.notes: Conservation laws, shocks, compressible ducts, high-speed heat transfer and supersonic flow.
